description: Source code for the PlatformService in Mattermost, handling platform-related functionalities such as database access, caching, licensing, configuration, and plugin management.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Main service struct managing platform functionalities such as database, cache, licensing, configuration, plugins, and search engine integration.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new PlatformService instance with configuration and options.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the platform service, including status updates, hubs, and configuration and license listeners.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the platform service, stopping hubs, caches, and other background processes.

methods.name: ShutdownMetrics
methods.description: Stops the metrics server if running.

methods.name: ShutdownConfig
methods.description: Removes configuration listeners and closes the config store.

methods.name: SetTelemetryId
methods.description: Sets the telemetry ID and triggers propagation events.

methods.name: PostTelemetryIdHook
methods.description: Triggers events to propagate the telemetry ID.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the service.

methods.name: initEnterprise
methods.description: Initializes enterprise features like cluster, Elasticsearch, LDAP diagnostics, license, and access control.

methods.name: TotalWebsocketConnections
methods.description: Returns the total number of active websocket connections.

methods.name: ShutdownMetrics
methods.description: Stops the metrics server if active.

methods.name: ShutdownConfig
methods.description: Removes config listeners and closes config store.

methods.name: SetSharedChannelService
methods.description: Sets the shared channel service interface.

methods.name: GetSharedChannelService
methods.description: Retrieves the shared channel service interface.

methods.name: SetPluginsEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the plugin environment hook runner.

methods.name: GetPluginStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves plugin statuses, including cluster ID.

methods.name: getPluginManifests
methods.description: Retrieves plugin manifests from the plugin environment.

methods.name: FileBackend
methods.description: Returns the file backend used for storing files.

methods.name: ExportFileBackend
methods.description: Returns the export file backend.

methods.name: LdapDiagnostic
methods.description: Returns LDAP diagnostic interface.

methods.name: DatabaseTypeAndSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns database type and current schema version.
